talk._doc: Charme talk-down and question back-off (story 7.5, services/talkLogic.js, entities/TalkDown.js). At Aerger levels 1..maxLevel a bully's touch does not catch at once: first the Charme check succeeds with chance base + perPoint * Charme (at most max, never sure), then a question (data/activities.json talk, learning context bully) can make him back off; success ends the chase. A wrong answer is gentle: nobody is caught this time and a touch is swallowed for graceSeconds of play.

lookout._doc: Phone lookouts (story 7.2, entities/Lookouts.js): the map objects `lookout` stand and watch with a phone. A player on foot or riding inside `radius` px who is not hidden is spotted: the lookout emits lookout:spotted, calls the gang (the Aerger level rises by `raise`, at least to 1) and exposes the player for `exposeSeconds` (hiding spots do not work meanwhile). A lookout needs `cooldown` seconds before it spots again.

boss._doc: The boss bully (story 7.3): one boss joins the chase from `joinLevel` on, on top of the quality cap (the pool keeps a slot for it), bigger and golden. Each year's boss has a name (i18n `name`) and ONE trait that measurably changes the chase. Klasse 3: Rocco, trait `unshakable` - props and slingshot hits do not lure him away (no distraction) and a block or Kiai sends him stumbling for only `stumbleMult` of the usual time. The name and the trait are an assumption (the user has not chosen them yet): change them here and in the i18n texts boss.<id>.*.

gang._doc: Gang tactics (story 7.1): from `fromLevel` on the bullies that can see their target do not all run straight at it. Each takes a slot (its place among the bullies out): `ahead` is how far in front of the target it aims in units of `leadPx` along the target's running direction (or from the bully's side when the target stands still), `side` how far to the left (+) or right (-) in units of `flankPx`. So one runs straight, one cuts the way off, two come from the sides. Within `closeIn` px they all go for the target itself.

coop._doc: Two players share ONE Ärger level. Level rises from the turf or bumps of either player. It falls only when EVERY player in play is safe (escape: hidden hideSeconds, or far and unseen farSeconds, judged per player): one player hiding while the other is seen or close keeps the chase. A caught player leaves the chase (the catching bully goes GIVE_UP); the level clears once no bully is chasing any more. level.coopExtraByLevel adds at most one bully per level when two play, never past the quality maxBullies. switchRatio: a bully changes its target only when another visible player scores below this share of its current target's score (squared distance / weight^2), so it does not flip-flop.
